ravi_marketing: Afternoon 4B0 noticed inbound routing SLA creep after the webinar. Median claim up to ~9m for APAC leads. Can we triage?
june_salesops: Saw enrichment 504 spikes; leads stuck in RR claim loop. Any sample IDs?
ravi_marketing: Sample lead 00D-77221. Trace: 
POST /enrich 200 2024-03-21T01:22:03Z
GET /enrich/00D-77221 2024-03-21T01:22:04Z 504
RR claim retry attempt=2 backoff=8s
RR assign success 2024-03-21T01:31:05Z
june_salesops: That 8s backoff + retries is killing SLA. Proposal: add a fast-fail policy: if enrichment not returned in 6s, run lightweight assign with minimal fields, then patch when enrichment completes.
leo_revops: +1 for fast-fail. Also propose low-touch rule for lead_score < 18: route to SDR queue without enrichment and schedule async enrichment in 1h.
mira_infra: I can implement feature flag for fast-fail and metrics tags step=[enqueue,enrich,claim,patch]. Will also add region-separated RR worker pools to prevent NA/EMEA/APAC interference.
sam_support: Need playbook entry: when median_claim >420s, page revops + infra. Include these diagnostics: `kubectl get pods -l app=rr-worker -n routing` and KQL to surface enrichment 5xx rate.
june_salesops: Plan experiment: 2% traffic -> fast-fail, monitor median/P95 and conversion. Ramp if no negative signal.
leo_revops: I'll update the HS->SF mapping doc and notify CS and Sales Ops about the low-touch path. Also recommend a 24h re-enrich sweep for low-touch leads.
mira_infra: ETA: flag + metrics today, regional pools + re-enrich job next week. I'll land canary and open monitoring dashboard.
hs_sync_bot: HubSpot sync completed: 5 retried, 0 failed in last hour 4C4 https://internal.hubspot/log/1915554321
ravi_marketing: Thanks team 44D I'll draft the experiment brief (metrics: median_claim, p95_claim, conversion delta) and link it here once ready: https://go/redwood/docs/lead-routing-fast-fail
